what: An ESTIMATE of the pod's IMU errors from today's stills, not a calib_pod.py run (2026-11-01, judge of three analyses): corrected = (raw - bias) / scale per axis. Not for --install (incomplete, and named so its newest-file pick skips it). Pinned: z, now bias +0.281 and scale +0.31% (the 10-31 estimate's +0.205 / -0.54% mixed two lid-ups taken on USB at 12:48 and 13:44, which read 0.13-0.18 low, with the 22:49 lid-down). That z is an equal-weight fit of six placements: three lid-ups today (11:06, 11:08, 11:09-11:13) and three lid-downs (11:14 and 11:18 today, 22:49 on 10-31). The lid-downs disagree by up to 0.020 (11:18 read -9.570, settling to -9.555 after a wake, against -9.540 for the other two), so z is good to about +-0.01 / +-0.001. Not pinned today: x and y, kept from the 10-31 estimate (bar stills, on the cell). Today's USB-C-up face (-x, on a table with the cable plugged in and hanging) reads 0.019 high in |a| under that x, while 10-31's five +-x bar stills fit within 0.0025. Missing: the +x and +-y faces and every turn (the Adapter A puck is in the way). Gyro bias is the median over today's 112 stills; it drifts over 0.73-0.83 / -3.42..-3.29 / 2.18-2.22 deg/s, and the app re-estimates it at every still anyway. gz scale 1.010 is carried over from 10-31; x/y gyro scale unknown (null). Battery 4.15 V, not charging.
from: judge (cal11): accel z from bar-xiao-2026-11-01-1106-lid-up-rest.csv, -1108-flips-lid-down-usb-up.csv (+z 1-63 s and 90-342 s, -z 352-359.5 s), -1118-lid-down-then-usb-up.csv (-z 2-133 s) and bar-xiao-2026-10-31-2249-lid-down-rest.csv; accel x/y from pod-calib-estimate-2026-10-31.json; gyro bias calib_pod.still_runs over today's three files; rest calib_pod.analyze of the 1106 file

uncertainty.notes: z: the extreme lid-up x lid-down pairs give bz +0.272..+0.286, sz 1.0025..1.0039. The 11:18 pair alone (+0.276 / 1.0039) is the post-wake state, and the settled lid-downs (11:14, 22:49) with today's lid-ups give +0.284 / 1.0027. The x/y inputs move z by under 0.0002 / 0.0001. x: today's -x face alone fixes bx - 9.799 (sx - 1) = -0.2433 (the 10-31 x gives -0.2245); it is not used, because 10-31's -x and +x bar stills, taken in the gym's own condition (on the bar, on the cell, no cable), fit the 10-31 x within 0.0025.
